WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS units, COUNT(*) AS nrows
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date >= DATE '2025-11-03' AND n.business_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
mine AS (
    SELECT SUM(x.v) AS net_sales, SUM(x.t) AS test_net FROM (
      SELECT CASE WHEN p.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END AS v, CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END AS t
      FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
      JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT CASE WHEN p.category <> 'ZZ Test' THEN -r.refund_net ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN -r.refund_net ELSE 0 END
      FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
      WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') x
)
SELECT m.net_sales, m.test_net, (SELECT SUM(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS rpt_net,
 (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900) AS rpt_max
FROM mine m
